from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shlex
import subprocess
import time

ROOT = Path('/workspace/android-studio-parallel-sync-policy')
ARTIFACTS = Path('/workspace/android-studio-artifacts/parallel-sync-integration/runtime')
SOURCE = '4fb7a80eacc598a786b4b98c809d1df24a1b02ee'
PATHS = ['.', ':(glob,exclude)docs/android-studio/*.md',
         ':(exclude)docs/android-studio/reference-manifest.json',
         ':(exclude)docs/android-studio/test-parity.json',
         ':(glob,exclude)docs/android-studio/ports/*.json',
         ':(glob,exclude)docs/android-studio/evidence/**/*.log',
         ':(glob,exclude)docs/android-studio/evidence/**/*.json']

def sha(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT)

def snapshot():
    assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == SOURCE
    for cached in [False, True]:
        command = ['git', 'diff', '--quiet'] + (['--cached'] if cached else [])
        subprocess.run(command + [SOURCE, '--', *PATHS], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
    assert not git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '--', *PATHS)
    paths = [path.decode() for path in git('ls-files', '-z', '--', *PATHS).split(b'\0') if path]
    bindings = {path: sha(ROOT / path) for path in paths if (ROOT / path).is_file()}
    assert len(bindings) == 4730
    expected = json.loads((ARTIFACTS / 'whole-source-static-guard.json').read_text())
    assert bindings == expected['files']
    return {'source_commit': SOURCE, 'tree': git('rev-parse', SOURCE + '^{tree}').decode().strip(),
            'fixed_source_pathspec': PATHS, 'files': bindings,
            'index_hex': git('ls-files', '--stage', '-z').hex(),
            'status_hex': git('status', '--porcelain=v1', '-z').hex()}

before = snapshot()
before_file = ARTIFACTS / 'ui-full-default-suite-source-before.json'
assert not before_file.exists()
before_file.write_text(json.dumps(before, indent=2) + '\n')
freshness = []
for name in ['crates/android_tools/src/android_tools.rs', 'crates/android_ui/src/android_ui.rs']:
    path = ROOT / name
    digest, old_mtime = sha(path), path.stat().st_mtime_ns
    os.utime(path, None)
    assert sha(path) == digest
    freshness.append({'path': name, 'sha256': digest, 'before_mtime_ns': old_mtime,
                      'after_mtime_ns': path.stat().st_mtime_ns})
(ARTIFACTS / 'ui-full-default-suite-source-freshness.json').write_text(json.dumps({
    'source_commit': SOURCE, 'roots': freshness, 'only_source_mtime_changed': True
}, indent=2) + '\n')
assert snapshot() == before
command = ['cargo', 'test', '--locked', '-p', 'android_ui', '--lib', '--message-format=json']
started = time.monotonic()
log = ARTIFACTS / 'ui-full-default-suite.log'
with log.open('xb') as output:
    run = subprocess.run(['bash', '-lc',
        'source /workspace/cloud-environment/env.sh\nexport CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1\n' + shlex.join(command)],
        cwd=ROOT, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
after = snapshot()
receipt = {'source_commit': SOURCE, 'command': command, 'exit_code': run.returncode,
           'elapsed_seconds': time.monotonic() - started, 'log': str(log), 'log_sha256': sha(log),
           'whole_source_bindings': 4730, 'source_index_status_unchanged': before == after,
           'canonical_environment': '/workspace/cloud-environment/env.sh', 'CARGO_BUILD_JOBS': 1,
           'linker_output_redirection': False}
(ARTIFACTS / 'ui-full-default-suite-exit.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
(ARTIFACTS / 'ui-full-default-suite-source-after.json').write_text(json.dumps(after, indent=2) + '\n')
assert before == after and run.returncode == 0, receipt
raw = log.read_text()
groups = [tuple(map(int, values)) for values in re.findall(
    r'^test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored; (\d+) measured; (\d+) filtered out;',
    raw, re.M)]
assert groups == [(125, 0, 1, 0, 0)], groups
artifacts = []
for line in raw.splitlines():
    if not line.startswith('{'):
        continue
    item = json.loads(line)
    if item.get('reason') != 'compiler-artifact':
        continue
    if not item.get('package_id', '').split('#')[0].endswith('android_ui'):
        continue
    assert item['target']['src_path'].startswith(str(ROOT) + '/')
    if item['executable'] and item['profile']['test']:
        assert not item['fresh']
        executable = Path(item['executable'])
        item.update(executable_bytes=executable.stat().st_size,
                    executable_sha256=sha(executable))
        artifacts.append(item)
assert len(artifacts) == 1
receipt.update(passed=125, failed=0, pre_existing_ignored=1, filtered=0,
               groups=groups, normal_current_worktree_compiler_artifacts=artifacts,
               ignored_native_test_unchanged=True)
(ARTIFACTS / 'ui-full-default-suite-verified.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in receipt.items()
                  if key != 'normal_current_worktree_compiler_artifacts'}, indent=2), flush=True)
